budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Use shared hedges, blankets, hoe, watering can and moving pollinator to grow six original plants, harvest them and carry their produce to the village.
task.natural_termination: Natural end when every bed is harvested or dead and no active produce remains in the world. This includes completed delivery and crop-loss exhaustion; otherwise truncate at tick 180.
task.interaction: Moving a hedge alters wind shelter, moving sunlight shadows, walking space and the insect route. A blanket preserves a bed against frost while preventing growth, pollination, tending and harvesting until physically removed. Shared single tools and one-item hands require labor and inventory handoffs.
task.observation_access: Fully observable village. Every role receives identical flattened clock, ground map, all worker/bed/object/insect/facility positions, plot labels, crop stages/moisture/soil/frost/alive/harvested/pollination/shelter/shade/cover state, object kinds/holders/deployment/blanket assignment/water, insect route index/direction, weather phase and delivery counters. Inactive produce slots remain explicit in the native observation but are not drawn as active objects. All public scene attributes are contained in the same observation.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Plants pollinated for the first time
Shadow direction: +1 east early day, -1 west later day

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
